4. Monitor their usage: Keep track of how much time your children spend on their electronics and remind them to take breaks and engage in other activities.

5. Lead by example: Set a good example by limiting your own use of technology and practicing healthy habits outside of screen time.

By using these strategies and setting clear boundaries, you can help your children make more informed decisions about their technology usage and reduce the risk of developing health problems related to excessive use.
